lines.en: The moment the lights die, I start walking.
All black around me. I need not see.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在黑暗里很轻。
lines.en: My steps are light in the dark.
I pass through unlit corridors.
I creep along the base of the wall.
In the black, only my outline shows.
Lamps dim further where I pass.
The thread above me has vanished.

lines.zh: 我贴着走廊的墙，一步也没偏。
lines.en: I hug the corridor wall, not straying a step.
The dark makes my cloth darker.
I turn slowly in the dark.
Without light, I still walk.
I stand in the dark, motionless.
The lights have not come on.

lines.zh: 我在慢慢呼吸，其实不用。
lines.en: I breathe slowly, though I need not.
The thread sways above me.
A speck of red in the black.
I listen to the rhythm of your steps.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛看不见，但我知道。
lines.en: My eyes cannot see, yet I know.
I wait for the power to return.
This whole floor is black.
Head down, very quiet.
I found the wall and stand.
The lights will not come soon.
No one is on this floor.
My cloth drinks the dark.
The lights are out. You cannot see me.
Your torch is out.
Listen. The corridor is silent.
In the dark, I have been watching you.
Turn around, and I am there.
There are no lights on this floor.
The lights go out, and I arrive.
Your hand gropes in the air.
I am on your left.
Do not shout. Sound carries far.
The power in this building answers to me.
The dark in this building is mine.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸喷在我脸上，很热。
lines.en: Your breath hits my face, hot.
I cannot see you, yet I know.
You are against the wall.
There is a little power left in the tube.
I can stand without any light.
Listen. The pipes are ticking.
I am more patient in the dark.
A tear in the cloth.
I gave half a step in the dark.
One thread has given way.
I make no sound, but it hurts.
The red glow dimmed.
I touch my own body.
The dark did not brighten.
This is hardly a wound.

lines.zh: 灯灭的那一下，我记住了。
lines.en: The instant the lights died, I remembered.
That little light. Give it.
Does your torch still work?
Hold it higher.
I want that bit of brightness.
Set it down so I can see.
This is getting hot.
Give it and I will stop following.

lines.zh: 把手电放低，别照我的线。
lines.en: Lower the torch; do not shine it on my string.
A little further. I cannot see.

lines.zh: 那点光晃两下，我就到你面前。
lines.en: That little light wavers twice, and I am before you.
You bumped into me. Soft.

lines.zh: 黑里你不知道撞了什么。
lines.en: In the dark you do not know what you hit.
I did not move an inch.
Your hand found cloth.
A touch in the dark, nothing more.
I am against the wall and you crowd in.
Do not pull my ear.
I shifted half a step.
You stood on my instep.
There is only me in the dark.
I have no body to offer.
This building keeps none of that.
Do not ask. The lights are going out.
I am only cloth.
Not at a time like this.
You cannot even see my face.
Keep clear of me.
I came for something else.
There is no such thing.
In the dark I can feel it.
I pick it up and cannot see it.
This one is cold.
This glows. Too bright.
I stamp it out.
I feel a thread.
That is not mine to mind.
The lights go out, and there I am.
You walked into the dark.
You are already in my hands.
The lights will not come back.
You hear me only when I move.
No light marks an exit.

lines.zh: 我听着你的鞋底擦过地砖。
lines.en: I listen to your soles scrape the floor tiles.
Red stands out more in the black.
Making noise will not help.
I am closing in on you.
Now it begins.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，指尖碰到你的影子。
lines.en: I raise my hand; my fingertip touches your shadow.
Listen closely.
Now is the moment.
Half a step behind you.
You walk faster than before.
Your hand searches the wall.
Did you catch that?
I am on the other side of the door.
The red glow is at your feet.

lines.zh: 我的手在你右侧伸过来。
lines.en: My hand reaches in from your right.
You have stopped walking.
Right here in this spot.
This one.
The hand is already out.
I seize it now.
Do not look behind you.
Very close now.
This is where it ends.
I catch you in the dark.
A hand comes from the side.

lines.zh: 我推你撞上墙，灯管晃了一下。
lines.en: I shove you into the wall and the light tube sways.
Stitches come out of the cloth.
I press against your back.
You can see nothing.
Blood is black in the dark too.
You throw me off and run two steps.
This hand of mine is very light.
The red glow flashed once.
The light flickered, then died.
Not next time.
Every light on the floor dies at once.
An outline appears in the black.
I come with the blackout.
The light here has been taken away.
A thread hangs in the black.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，什么也看不见。
lines.en: I raise a hand and see nothing.
I have no need of light.
The building has gone quiet.
A speck of red light.
You are still standing there.
I turn slowly to the side.
My cloth is blacker than the dark.

lines.zh: 你手电的余光是最后的。
lines.en: The last of your torch is all that remains.
I came two steps closer.
I am standing firm.
Listen. Listen closely.
I am right behind you.
There is no way out of here.
The firelight stings; I retreat into the black.
The dark is deeper in water.
The flash whiten the whole corridor.
In the dark, the arrow cannot find me.

lines.zh: 这光把黑暗撕开一条缝。
lines.en: This light tears a seam in the dark.
I do not eat, yet I thin.

lines.zh: 电光把我的轮廓照出来。
lines.en: The flash reveals my outline.
This black is like the black below.
